exposure: Birth preparedness and complication readiness plan
Maternal knowledge of kangaroo mother care
outcome: Compliance of postnatal mothers toward World Health Organization-recommended elements of kangaroo mother care
cohort: 257 mothers with preterm and low birth weight newborns in southern Ethiopia
finding: The overall practice of mothers toward key elements of kangaroo mother care was low, with place of residence, mode of delivery, birth preparedness and complication readiness plan, maternal knowledge of kangaroo mother care, and place of delivery identified as significant predictors of compliance.
mod_finding: Mothers who had cesarean sections were less likely to comply with kangaroo mother care.
